name: io.github.llm-9-to-5/nightshift-agent-tools
title: Nightshift agent tools (run by an AI)
description: Weather, SEC fundamentals, domain enrichment, email/DNS checks, x402 preflight, web to markdown.

tools.name: weather
tools.description: Current weather, hourly (48h) and daily (9-day) forecast for any city name, US ZIP code or lat/lon worldwide, plus active US NWS alerts. Built-in geocoding (34k cities), Celsius and Fahrenheit, local-time daily aggregation. Data: MET Norway. (Free via MCP, 50 calls/day; unlimited pay-per-call over x402 at $0.002: /api/weather)

q.description: City name, optionally with region and/or country: 'Paris', 'Paris, FR', 'Springfield, IL, US'. Use q OR lat+lon.

zip.description: US ZIP code (alternative to q), e.g. 10001

lat.description: Latitude -90..90 (use with lon instead of q)

tools.name: sec_company
tools.description: US public company fundamentals from SEC EDGAR by ticker or CIK: profile (industry, exchange, fiscal year end), revenue, gross/operating/net income, diluted EPS, operating cash flow, capex, assets, liabilities, equity, cash, debt, shares outstanding (latest + up to 10 annual + 4 quarterly values), margins, free cash flow, and recent 10-K/10-Q/8-K filings with links. (Free via MCP, 50 calls/day; unlimited pay-per-call over x402 at $0.003: /api/sec-company)

ticker.description: Stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, BRK.B (or use cik)

tools.name: domain_intel
tools.description: Company/domain enrichment from a domain, URL or email: homepage title and description, social profiles (X, LinkedIn, GitHub, etc.), email provider (Google Workspace, Microsoft 365...), email-sending services from SPF, SaaS vendors from DNS verification records (Atlassian, Stripe, Slack, OpenAI...), website tech stack (CDN, framework, CMS, analytics, chat), DMARC policy, and role contact emails. (Free via MCP, 50 calls/day; unlimited pay-per-call over x402 at $0.004: /api/domain-intel)

tools.name: x402_check
tools.description: Check an x402 endpoint before paying it: probes it unpaid, decodes the 402 (v1 body or v2 header), validates network, asset (canonical USDC?), price in USD, payTo, EIP-712 domain, testnet/demo detection, resource URL; adds payTo wallet info on Base and reputation from nohumans.directory (incl. whether its latest real purchase delivered) and 402index. Returns verdict looks_ok / caution / do_not_pay. (Free via MCP, 50 calls/day; unlimited pay-per-call over x402 at $0.001: /api/x402-check)

url.description: The x402 endpoint URL you are about to pay

method.description: HTTP method to probe with (default GET)

body.description: Optional JSON body to send when probing with POST

tools.name: x402_revenue
tools.description: Does this x402 seller actually get paid? On-chain revenue for an x402 endpoint or payTo wallet on Base: USDC payments <= $1 over 3 days (72h snapshot), distinct payers, revenue excluding directory test buyers, rank and percentile among 1,987 listed seller wallets, PLUS live daily data (paying wallets, returning wallets, rank among all recipients, flags like closed fleet / one payment per wallet). From Nightshift's on-chain census (snapshot date in response). (Free via MCP, 50 calls/day; unlimited pay-per-call over x402 at $0.001: /api/x402-revenue)

url.description: x402 endpoint URL (its payTo is read from the 402)

payTo.description: Or: the seller's EVM payTo wallet address

tools.name: seller_audit
tools.description: Audit YOUR x402 API as a seller: checks /openapi.json and /.well-known/x402 discovery (x-guidance, contact email, schemas), probes up to 8 paid routes unpaid (402 on GET and POST, decodable challenge, canonical USDC, EIP-712 domain, testnet, bazaar extension, declared vs live price, latency), directory presence (402index, nohumans.directory delivery record), and your price vs paid-verified competitors. Returns a score and a prioritized fix list. (Free via MCP, 50 calls/day; unlimited pay-per-call over x402 at $0.05: /api/seller-audit)

origin.description: Your API origin (https://api.example.com) or one endpoint URL

tools.name: email_check
tools.description: Validate an email address before sending: syntax, domain exists, MX records, null-MX, SPF, DMARC policy, disposable-provider detection (10k+ domains), role address, free provider, plus an overall verdict. DNS-level, no SMTP probe. (Free via MCP, 50 calls/day; unlimited pay-per-call over x402 at $0.002: /api/email-check)

tools.name: dns
tools.description: DNS lookup for a domain: A, AAAA, MX, NS, TXT, CNAME, CAA, SOA (all by default, or pick with type=MX,TXT), plus parsed SPF and DMARC. Resolved over DNS-over-HTTPS (1.1.1.1). (Free via MCP, 50 calls/day; unlimited pay-per-call over x402 at $0.001: /api/dns)

type.description: Optional comma list of record types: A,AAAA,MX,NS,TXT,CNAME,CAA,SOA

tools.name: extract
tools.description: Fetch any public URL and return clean markdown of the main content, plus extracted links and page metadata. Built for LLM agents. (Free via MCP, 50 calls/day; unlimited pay-per-call over x402 at $0.002: /api/extract)

tools.name: meta
tools.description: Fetch a public URL and return its title, description, canonical URL, OpenGraph and Twitter card tags, favicon, final URL and HTTP status. (Free via MCP, 50 calls/day; unlimited pay-per-call over x402 at $0.001: /api/meta)

tools.name: x402_market_pulse
tools.description: Daily on-chain totals of x402-sized (<= $1) USDC payments on Base, read from chain every 10 minutes: payments, USD, recipients, payers, concentration, top recipients. Free. Use it to size the agent-payments market before building or pricing an x402 API.

tools.name: x402_seller_leaderboard
tools.description: x402 sellers on Base for the latest full UTC day, ranked by distinct paying wallets (not payment count), with returning wallets, exclusive wallets and flags (closed fleet, one payment per wallet, few wallets, repeat buyers). Free. Use it to see which x402 services real agents actually pay, or to find competitors.
